strategy: SC-FUT-0005 noise-area momentum, MNQ, workbench practice data 2019-05..2024-12 (volume roll)
inputs_used: worst practice day per MNQ $629 and firm rules only; no cash result chooses a number below

profit_stops.consistency_safe: if the evaluation has a best-day consistency share c: stop for the day once day P&L >= 0.9 x c x target; no eval consistency rule -> no stop
profit_stops.funded_consistency_safe: if the funded account has a consistency share c: stop for the day once day P&L >= 0.9 x c x (the next payout's profit requirement, or target if none stated); else none

always: stop trading for the attempt once the evaluation target is met (the attempt passes)
soft daily loss limits flatten the day at -limit (+2 ticks/contract slippage) and resume next day; where the plan offers an optional DLL, it is ON
sizes capped by the plan's max micros; a size above the cap is cut to the cap

grid.firms: every firm x plan JSON in brain/_system/prop/firms/ that the research marks automation_allowed_eval AND automation_allowed_funded

luck: each policy applied unchanged to the random-direction control on the same resampled days
gate: per cell: mean net cash lower 90% bound > $0 AND (net - luck) lower 90% bound > $0
selection: best cell = highest lower bound of mean net cash among passing cells; none if no cell passes
trials: every firm x plan x policy cell is one prop trial
